description.value: Motonobu Udon is Vancouver's first authentic Japanese udon restaurant, opened in August 2020 during the pandemic and earning Michelin Guide Bib Gourmand recognition consecutively in 2023, 2024, and 2025. Chef Shin Iwamoto follows his grandmother's Sanuki-style family recipe, using locally sourced Canadian flour to produce handmade noodles freshly cut and boiled to order. Located on East Hastings Street near PNE Playland, it operates as a walk-in-only spot with takeout and Uber Eats delivery available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and corroborates all OSM contact fields (phone, address, website). Takeout is confirmed by website text 'Online order Take away udon Uber for delivery services Uber Eats' and OSM takeaway=yes. No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; OSM internet_access=no supports Wi-Fi being false, though website does not explicitly mention it.
concerns: Website footer contains a 'Table Reservation' form widget contradicting the prominently repeated 'No Reservations, Walk in Only' text throughout the site — appears to be an unused template element, not an actual reservation service.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A Michelin Bib Gourmand-recognized restaurant on a key Vancouver cycling corridor, offering walk-in dining and takeout — a solid food stop for touring cyclists.
